A '''coalition''' of [[Evocii]] banded together and were able to purchase several properties on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], but the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] who ruled the moon attempted to nullify the sales.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Return on Investment}}</ref>
